notesStmt.note: This manuscript was likely composed sometime in 1887.
A draft of a poem which was first published in The Cosmopolitan in October 1887, under the title "Shakspere-Bacon's Cipher." The poem was then reprinted in Good-Bye My Fancy (1891).

lg.head: The Mystic cipher
a hint for scientists
lg.l: Oft think Doubtless in each and all
In book, in man in the songs bequeathed—nor them alone—,—in every object,
Part All part of ac each infold ‸after the rest the meaning at the last
A mystic ‸luring, puzzling cipher is secreted
We Dear prize! well may you rest unknown eternal source
Centre and spur of science, life, love, hope
Well may ‸you rest fore'er unsolved unknown
